title: Setting off blocks any send; every send is recorded; bounces not tracked
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Create and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A customer whose 'Send preventive maintenance notifications' setting is ON, with an asset that has a preferred contact carrying an email address (e.g. customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co', unit 'Truck 12', contact 'Dave Brabay').
  3. The asset has one or more services currently inside their reminder window. Open the asset's contact card.
custom_steps:
1. Turn the customer's 'Send preventive maintenance notifications' setting off and confirm no reminder can be sent for any of their assets.
  2. Send a reminder and open the audit.
  3. Check 'Last sent' on the contact card.
  4. Confirm bounces are not tracked.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A customer whose notification setting is off cannot be sent a reminder for any of their assets (the setting lives on the customer record, not the asset or enrolment).
  • Every send is recorded in the audit with the message, the recipients, the user who sent it and the timestamp, and updates 'Last sent' on the contact card.
  • Bounces are not tracked; nothing reports that a reminder failed to arrive.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10575 (S19, The customer reminder email (sent by hand)); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S19; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-N3: “A customer whose notification setting is off cannot be sent a reminder for any of their assets, per S14-R9. The setting lives on the customer record, not on the asset and not on the enrolment”
  • S19-R14: “Every send is recorded in the audit with the message, the recipients, the user who sent it and the timestamp, per S21-R5, and updates Last sent on the contact card, per S14-R12. Today only invoice and estimate emails are recorded, on their work order, so this record is new”
  • S19-E4: “Bounces are not tracked. Nothing will report that a reminder failed to arrive”
